[spoiler=Astanir matters][b][u]The Argossians of the two lower islands[/u][/b]
While the Nordiheimian navy would save as many of the Argossians from the two lower islands as they could, both civilian and military, there would unfortunatly not be many that could be saved.
Less then 200 civilains remained when all was said and done wich would mean that it was rather easy to acomedate them on Laguz island, though the initial plan of giving them a separate area to live in was scraped as it would render them dangerously isolated, instead they were setteled close to the local Nordiheimians in such a way that they could have time for them self if they needed it but close enough that they could interact with them if that was what they wanted to.
The locals were very welcoming towards the Argossians as they had heard about what that they had gone trough, and a team of psychiatrists was sent to help them deal with and prosses the horrible trauma that they had experienced.

The remains of the Argossian militia from the islands were not in much bether shape with only about 150 personell remaining in what could be called good shape, those that was in bad shape would return to the remaining civilian population, but they could still fight and was honestly eager to do so especialy if it meant a chance for revenge or to take their homes back.
It was decided to send them to train with the Nordiheimian special forces in jungel and marine warfare as they seemed to be naturaly inclined to such fighting, pluss it would be neceseary if they were to ever take their home back anyway.
The training would also help them to focus and keep their minds buisy as to prevent them from potentialy sink into depression or dark toughts, with some help from the specialized army mental health profesionals of course.

They would also be joined by the 1000 volunteirs from mainland Astanir who would also be given marine training, ones trained they might have a force that could one day take back the two islands by their own hands, someting that would be important to build a fealing of unity among the different tribes so that their faction wouldn't fall appart if they managed to winn their freedom after the civil war.

[b][u]The Kuhaw-Astan of Mainland Astanir[/u][/b]

It had become obvious that the different aspects of a military could not be neglected in anyway when it came to the Argossians of Astanir, they needed to be put on the path of getting their own functioning military for both ground, air and sea or they would simply have any hole that existed taken advantage off and used ageinst them, as such several things needed to be done and done fast.

[u]Creating a defence towards the sea:[/u]
To strenghten their ability to defend themself ageinst naval attack Nordiheim would give them two tings;

First ting would be 10 Yawkyawk-class missile boats from Nordiheimian reserve fleet, these had good point defence from both the Tyr-1 Automatic AA module (basicly the Phalanx CIWS) and its SAM system (32 missiles with 12 km range) to handle air treaths of different types.
Its 16 anti-ship missiles with a range of 143 km (Harpoon missiles) also made it a deadly treath to any navy the Junta or Isolationists might send ageinst them and would make a good adition to their naval force.
((its basicly a slightly modefied Sa'ar 4.5 Hetz subclass missile boat))

secound ting would be for the Kuhaw-Astan land defences against naval treaths, they would be supplied a older variant of anti-ship missile systems that could be placed on trucks or Kangaroo MAMIVs for mobility, these only had a 70 km range but are both highly mobile and very easy to hide, someting that would allow them to essentialy be hiden so that they coulden't be taken out easely and provide any hostile ships that came into range with a nasty ambush suprice, especialy together with newer and better sensor and targeting systems.
They could also be provided in decent numbers in a short amount of time, wich could be important.

[u]Contesting the Air:[/u]

The Kuhaw-Astan ranks would be carefully gone trough to find any induviduals that could be used to create a airforce for the Argossian faction, be it in the form of promissing abilities or prior experience with aircraft, these would be given training from Nordiheimian merchenary pilots in how to fly the KJ-5H Cockatoo fighter jet, wich Nordiheim would provide 50 of at this point to the readied air fields.
Some these future pilots would be trained to use the AH-3 2B Argos Hornet Attack Helicopter as they could prove good for platforms of AA and ground attack missiles.

[u]Defending the ground:[/u]

A good SAM (the main ting here would be basicly Patriot systems) network would also be set up for the Argossians, with help and advice from Nordiheimian military advisors, together with point defence being properly split up and organized for the ground forces, this would provide a much needed defence for them ageinst missiles and drones incase that would apare to treathen their future plans.

In adition the the ground army would be given 100 Iron Drake 2E tanks and 50 Wombat 1 heavy APCs, wich had been upgraded with chemical warfare protection/sealing, to form the first heavy army units in the Argossian military, these they could use as armored fists to punch trough junta and isolationists lines in the south, the advisers allready there would help them with how to propperly use them.
These would come together with more Platypus 1B and AFV-5G105 Cassowary, and a lot of protective gear and heavier artilery pieces in the 155mm range, in an effort to provide them with the ability to work their way over to the Sui-mana enclave gradualy over time.

Linking their two areas together would allow better weapons and vehicles to be provided to the Sui-mana, someting they were curently lacking and wich was rather difficult to provide them.

[b][u]Meeting with the [nation]Qianxun[/nation] and the "Democrats"[/u][/b]

Having recived the message from the Sui-mana of having a propper meeting with the "Democratic" faction on the east side of Astanir Nordiheim would send a diplomatic team to part of it at the Argossians wishes.
The idea that they would bring to the table for a possible solution for the future of Astanir was a two nation solution were they each side signed a mutual defence and cooperation treaty between them in matters of military, economy and how to resolve future differences, but at the same time they would essentialy be their own nations that would be able to voice their disaproval in important matters and do their own tings within their own borders to suit the differences in culture and religeon that at this time could not trully see "eye to eye".

In a way it would be a lose union of nations to allow them to defend themself better from outside forces, be it militarily or economicaly, then they would be able to alone as tiny nations.[/spoiler]

Far to much.

Remember, GDP is not how much money your country has available.

It is the gross amount of the worth of the product produced in your nation. (Hence, its name. Gross Domestic Production)

If it was 12% of your GDP. That means

A. You are spending way to much on your military, likely superceding everything else and causing a massive deficit if you actually want to fund anything else in your country.

B. Your like north korea, and most of the worth of the products that are produced in your country goes towards the military.
